## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by very weak sector breadth (≤4/11) and both Financials and Industrials negative — two independent confirmations. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) with Energy/Materials dominance; style: Value/Cyclical skew.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND. Materials next: DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY; Utilities showing patchy strength: CEG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: -6.70%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology is weakest: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND. Financials and Consumer Discretionary also lag: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND and DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +8.33% | 1M: +25.28%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +7.97% | 1M: -17.75%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +7.81% | 1M: +23.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — cyclical/value concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -7.09%) BELOW TREND, DIS (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -12.44%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -11.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -10.11%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +5.58%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and select Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: SLB (1W: +14.73%), DOW (1W: +11.38%), MPC (1W: +8.33%), OXY (1W: +7.59%), PSX (1W: +7.30%) — mostly Energy/Materials. Note minor divergences: FCX, PPG, CEG show sharp 1W gains vs negative 1M (RECOVERY) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech is in clear weakness with broad distribution: AAPL (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -11.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -10.69%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND. Sector momentum remains negative and is a principal source of downside risk.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials are broadly weak: JPM (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.02% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -2.43% | 1M: -5.93%) BELOW TREND. No evidence of financial leadership to offset Tech pain; sector is contributing to the RISK-OFF backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed to soft: JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY and PFE (1W: +0.26% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY show defensive bids, while UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -14.07%) BELOW TREND underperform. Sector is not uniformly defensive; watch headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Value/Cyclical exposure within current RISK-OFF context — energy and select materials (XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +4.67% | 1M: +14.66%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to high-multiple large-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND (META, GOOGL, MSFT); monitor JNJ catalyst and INTU CORRECTION for potential stabilization signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND for continuation, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND on energy flows, JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY on FDA approval headlines. BEARISH: META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND on legal fallout, UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND on regulatory headlines, PANW (1W: -9.78% | 1M: -1.59%) BELOW TREND on sector downgrades.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +17.83%) — breadth and flows favor continuation; Materials (1W: +4.91% | 1M: -6.36%) may follow. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -4.56% | 1M: -7.18%) and Financials (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -9.37%) as drivers of broader weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA reclaiming its 1W range/short-term moving average as a stabilization trigger while it remains BELOW TREND (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -9.39%). Monitor AAPL holding recent 1M support for RECOVERY confirmation (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -8.85%). XOM above near-term breakout levels would signal energy continuation (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) while JPM failing to stabilize would deepen Financials weakness (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -7.61%).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+80): Darzalex self-injectable approval; JNJ (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -1.24%) RECOVERY — sentiment confirmed by price action. AVGO (+50): Broadcom AI/optical push (cross-check price for follow-through). MS (+50): Morgan Stanley filing headline — monitor for flow impact on Financials.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-50): Legal fallout; META (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -19.91%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PANW (-50): sector downgrades; PANW (1W: -9.78% | 1M: -1.59%) BELOW TREND — confirmatory. UNH (-50): regulatory/breakup headlines; UNH (1W: -6.01% | 1M: -8.94%) BELOW TREND — headline risk aligns with price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +14.73% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +11.38% | 1M: +38.14%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is concentrated Tech selling (META, GOOGL, MSFT BELOW TREND) and headline-driven divergences (UNH, OXY) that could keep breadth suppressed.
